trial_court: Additional Metropolitan Sessions Judge for the Trial of JHCBBC-cum-Additional Family Judge, Hyderabad, M.C.No.152/2015
case_name: Krishnaveni Rai v. State Of Telangana, Rep Pp Anr.

parties.respondent_defendant: State Of Telangana, Rep Pp Anr., husband

facts_of_case: Petitioner is wife of respondent No.2, who married her after consulting astrologers. She was subjected to mental and physical torture, leading her to file complaint against him for offences under Sections 498-A, 406 and 500 IPC.

legal_principles.principle: A marriage solemnised after the commencement of this Act shall be null and void if it contravenes any one of the conditions specified in clauses (i), (iv) and (v) of section 5.
legal_principles.held: Any marriage solemnised after the commencement of this Act shall be null and void and may, on a petition presented by either party thereto against the other party, be so declared by a decree of nullity if it contravenes any one of the conditions specified in clauses (i), (iv) and (v) of section 5.

legal_principles.principle: When a marriage has been dissolved by a decree of divorce, it shall be lawful for either party to marry again if there is no right of appeal against the decree or if the time for appealing has expired without an appeal having been presented.
legal_principles.held: it shall be lawful for either party to marry again after dissolution of a marriage if there is no right of appeal against the decree or, if there is such a right of appeal, the time for appealing has expired without an appeal having been presented, or an appeal has been presented but has been dismissed

outcome.final_order: The impugned order is set aside, and the petitioner is entitled to maintenance as sought for.
